newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU steel-packaging makers say recycling hits 41pct.
newsitem.headline: EU steel-packaging makers say recycling hits 41pct.

text.p: European steel packaging producers said recycling rates of their products hit 41 percent in 1995, 20 percent up on the previous year, a statement said.

"The average rate of 41 percent represents about one million tonnes of steel collected and recycled," said the Association of European Packaging Steel Producers, which added that its members accounted for 96 percent of Europe's packaging steel.

"Germany, with a recycling rate of 67 percent, is setting the trend in Europe, followed closely by the Netherlands with 58 percent, France with 40 percent, Belgium with more than 30 percent, Spain with 17 percent and the UK with 16 percent."

The Association predicted rates would rise to an EU average of 65 percent by the year 2005, adding that each tonne of recycled steel meant savings of 75 percent of the energy used to make virgin steel, 40 percent water, 1.5 tonnes of iron ore and half a tonne of coke.
